formulas.ascii: GADF = 1 - ADCM / ADAM; ADCM = sum over classes c of sum over rows i in c of |x_i - median_c|; ADAM = sum over all counted rows of |x_i - median of all rows|. GADF = 1 when ADAM = 0. Only rows with a class below k, an unmasked flag and a finite value are counted; medians are exact (mean of the two middle values).
